Attached: 1 image

What do you get when you put every character that exists on a single page?

A completely useless and deeply satisfying exercise, and I hope you enjoy reading about it!

Sneak preview:

● Most characters you read on an unstyled HTML page aren’t in Times New Roman, they’re in Times.
● There’s a Unicode block for an ancient, undeciphered script.
● There is a codepoint for Pac-Man!
